name: Sri Gokul Krishnan

hero.title: I design, build and bring digital products to life.
hero.lead: I'm Sri Gokul Krishnan. I work directly with founders and businesses to turn ideas into clear interfaces, fast websites and working products, from the first sketch to the shipped app.
hero.proof: I've also designed and built two products of my own, StayOnMap and Happenous. Both are live today.

intro: I'm a product designer and frontend developer. I work on the whole arc of a digital product: understanding the business problem, designing how it should work, and building the interface people actually use.

Today I'm building Cosmonus and its products, StayOnMap and Happenous: two apps that start from the real world, a home on a map and a plan with people nearby. Before that I ran AstusX, a design studio for startups, and worked on brand, web and product design for clients in India and the UK.

Beyond design, I find life's richness in diverse experiences. Video games offer an escape into fantastical worlds, the vibrant flavours of street food are a constant delight, novels pull me in, and exploring on my Himalayan motorcycle is pure adrenaline.

services.name: Product Design & UI/UX
services.for: SaaS founders and product teams with a web or mobile app that is hard to use, or not designed yet.
services.problem: People sign up and get lost. Features exist but nobody finds them. Each new screen looks a little different from the last.
includes: Dashboards, web apps and mobile apps
Design systems: tokens, components and rules
services.receive: Organised Figma files, a clickable prototype and a design system your developers can build from.

services.name: Website Design & Development
services.for: Startups and businesses whose website doesn't yet explain what they do, or doesn't bring in enquiries.
services.problem: Visitors leave without understanding the offer. The site is slow, hard to update, or looks unlike the company it represents.
includes: Visual design for desktop, tablet and mobile
Development in React, Next.js or plain HTML/CSS
services.receive: A live, fast, responsive website you own, with the source code and a walkthrough of how to update it.

services.name: MVP Design & Development
services.for: Founders with a product idea who need a first working version in front of real users.
services.problem: The idea is clear in your head but not yet on a screen, and you need something real to put in front of users.
includes: Product design for the core flows
Frontend development, AI-assisted where it speeds things up
Backend and API integrations where the project needs them
services.receive: A working first version of your product, plus the designs and code to keep building on.
services.proof: StayOnMap and Happenous, which I designed and built myself

services.name: Branding & Creative
services.for: New companies and companies that have outgrown their first logo.
services.problem: The brand feels like a placeholder, or every page and post looks like it came from a different company.
includes: Marketing websites in the new identity
services.receive: A brand kit with logo files, colours, type and usage rules, plus the assets to launch with.

process: Message me on WhatsApp or send the project form. We talk through what you're building, who it's for and when it needs to be live.
I write a short plan: what's included, the steps, the timeline and the price. Work starts only once you've agreed to it.
You see progress at every step and give feedback along the way, so there are no surprises at the end.
You get the files, the code and a walkthrough. I'm still a message away for fixes and whatever comes next.
experience: Building the company, its brand and website, and its products StayOnMap and Happenous.

Brand, web and product design for Fluid.work (UK), Thirus, Flawlex, Stopnosms, Game On and others.
